briefing: Markets were roughly flat today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P 500 -0.2%), a neutral session with no strong directional signal. With $689 in cash and 3 open portfolio slots, we deployed modestly into two diversified, non-overbought momentum names (GWRE, AAL) rather than idle cash, while holding all existing positions through the quiet session.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Diversification means spreading investments across different sectors so that a downturn in one industry doesn't sink your whole portfolio. Today we added an insurance-software name and an airline stock to a portfolio that was heavily weighted toward tech and semiconductors, reducing the risk that a single sector's bad news hurts us badly.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 分散投資是指將資金投放於不同行業,避免單一行業表現不佳時拖累整體投資組合。今日我們在原本以科技及半導體為主的組合中,加入了保險軟件股及航空股,藉此降低單一行業壞消息對整體投資組合造成重大衝擊的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ down 0.1% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%, reflecting a lack of strong catalysts on either side. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, trading stayed range-bound as investors awaited fresh data or earnings news. This kind of low-volatility, directionless session is typical between major economic releases.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢幾乎持平,納斯達克指數微跌0.1%,標普500指數則下跌0.2%,反映市場缺乏明顯的利好或利淡消息帶動方向。在沒有清晰的風險偏好訊號下,大市維持窄幅波動,投資者靜待新的經濟數據或業績消息公布。這種低波動、方向不明確的市況,在重大經濟數據公布之間頗為常見。

trades.reasoning: Guidewire shows a clean bullish setup (RSI 59.9, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20) and diversifies away from our tech/semiconductor-heavy holdings into insurance software.
American Airlines offers strong momentum (RSI 58.2, MACD bullish crossover, rising histogram) with room before overbought, adding sector diversification versus our current tech/industrial mix.
